cross-probe.about: 2026-11-22, #56. Read-only probe of the cross (state 9): the hook at 0x587A51 jumps to a cave at 0x5513B00 (.passbar) that logs the output of 0x5854b0 (EAX) at 0x3D59F00 (.data1, writable), [esp+0x50] at 0x3D59F04, [esp+0x54] at 0x3D59F0C and a count at 0x3D59F08. First version stored in .pch (not writable) and crashed the game. Does not change the cross. Undo: restore the original bytes and clear the cave (0x5513B00, 42 bytes).

cross-gauge.about: 2026-11-22, #56. In-memory test of a cross power gauge. The two calls of start_cross 0x588010 (0x588779 and 0x58891D, state 9 handler) go through caves 0x5513F00 / 0x5513F40: for a human (+0x47 < 8) whose circle (+0xB0 & 0x2000) is held and whose +0x4D < 0x80, the cross is not started, +0x4D += 2 and +0x4E = 0. The probe cave 0x5513D80 (hook 0x587A51) then replaces the game's power by 0x4000 + 0x3800 * gauge / 128 (the stat cap still applies). Not tried in game when written. Undo: restore the original bytes below, 0x587A51 to 8B 3D E8 0D BE 03, and clear the three caves.

cross-steer.about: 2026-11-23, #56. In-memory test: the left stick aims the cross. Hook in start_cross 0x588010 right after the game's receiver choice (0x585c70, body in the protection): for a human (+0x47 < 8) holding a direction (+0xB0 & 0xF0), the cave reads the stick angle (0x4B2F70) and takes the team-mate (on the pitch: 0x5091E0) whose place a little ahead (position + speed x byte 0x3BE127C, as the lofted pass does) is the nearest in angle to the stick, within 45 degrees (the 0x21 of 6A 21, cave +0x4A); it then writes the receiver +0x48 and the aimed point +0x9C/+0xA0. Nobody in the cone, no direction or CPU: the game's choice stays. Cave in the free end of .pch (0x5516000 on the installed exe). Tried 2026-11-23 (14 crosses, no crash): the receiver follows the stick, but the angle alone takes players much too far (other wing, other half): see cross-steer2. Do not apply both.

cross-steer2.about: 2026-11-23, #56. cross-steer with the distance: same hook (0x58802B), cave at 0x5516200. Distance wanted = 0x1000 + gauge (+0x4D) x 0x60 (the dwords of 05 00 10 00 00 and 69 C0 60 00 00 00, cave +0x54); among the team-mates within 45 degrees of the stick (83 F8 20, cave +0xBE) the receiver is the one with the smallest (angle difference + 1) x |distance - wanted|, as choose_lofted_receiver does. Nobody in the cone, no direction or CPU: the game's choice. Do not apply with cross-steer.

cross-steer3.about: 2026-11-23, #56. cross-steer2 completed after the user's test ('rather good') and his rule: without a direction on the stick the cross goes where the player faces, never the game's own choice. Same hook (0x58802B), cave at 0x5516400. Direction = stick angle (0x4B2F70) if a direction is held (+0xB0 & 0xF0), else the player's facing +0x26. Distance wanted = 0x1400 + gauge x 8 + gauge^2 x 7 / 16 (fitted on the measured landings: 5300 at gauge 11, 7200 at 62, 10850 at 98, 13200 at 128). Receiver = the team-mate within 45 degrees with the smallest (angle difference + 1) x |distance - wanted|; nobody in the cone: the game's receiver byte stays but the aimed point +0x9C/+0xA0 becomes passer + (cos, -sin)(direction) x wanted (float 2pi/65536 at the cave's end). CPU: untouched. Do not apply with cross-steer or cross-steer2.

cross-run-wait.about: 2026-11-23, #56. On the run the cross is started by the planner (sub-state +0x1A = 9, 0x4E3F4E..0x4E4010), which counts +0x220 up to [0x3BE1264] (8) before its first call of start_cross: the cross gauge only starts about 7 frames (0.12 s) after the press, so a short press on the run leaves with an empty gauge (measured: circle held 180 to 250 ms, gauge 0 to 61). Hook at the load of the counter (0x4E3F6A, mov dl,[esi+0x220], 6 bytes): for a human the counter is set to 7 first, so the increment makes 8 and the call (and the hold) comes at the first frame. Same idea as the cross gauge's wait phase hook (0x58889E). Cave in the free end of .pch (0x5516800), for the exe built by the patcher with the cross gauge.
